standard_prerequisites.name: The decomposition of a Noetherian space into finitely many irreducible components, and the inheritance of Noetherianity by subsets
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1591-1596)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the finite decomposition of a Noetherian neighbourhood.

core_obligations: Localize: given a point and a neighbourhood, choose a Noetherian neighbourhood and intersect it with the given one (proof lines 1588-1591)
Decompose: the intersection is Noetherian, hence a finite union of its irreducible components (proof lines 1591-1595)

Produce a connected neighbourhood: the union of the components containing the point is connected, contains an open subset and hence is a neighbourhood of the point inside the given neighbourhood (proof lines 1595-1600)
proof_roadmap: 取 x 的 Noetherian 邻域 E'，则 E ∩ E' 是 Noetherian。
把 E ∩ E' 分解为有限个不可约分支 Y_1, …, Y_n。
令 E'' = ∪_{x ∈ Y_i} Y_i：含 x 的连通子集，且含 E ∩ E' 中一个开集 ⇒ 是 x 的邻域，落在 E 内。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a locally Noetherian topological space is locally connected (author lemma at source lines 1582-1586, label lemma-locally-Noetherian-locally-connected). The proof (source lines 1588-1601) replaces a neighbourhood by its intersection with a Noetherian one, decomposes it into finitely many irreducible components and takes the union of those containing the point, which is connected and a neighbourhood (proof lines 1588-1600). The connected neighbourhood construction is the content. H3.
